scope: Proposition 2.1 (Binormal states and spectral shifts) of the manuscript “Expected amenable subalgebras preserving core commutants” (preprints/Expected-amenable-subalgebras-preserving-core-commutants-September-23-2026/Expected-amenable-subalgebras-preserving-core-commutants-September-23-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 290 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 af9a34e4fa4d0b23), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In this setting the following hold. (i) If a state Φ on B(H) satisfies Φ ◦ λ = Φ ◦ ρ = φ, Φ(eN ) = 1, Φ(f(XM )) = f(0) (f ∈ C0(R)), then, for a, b ∈ B, Φ(λ(a)ρ(b)) = ⟨aΩb, Ω⟩. (2) (ii) For each s ∈ R there is a unital completely positive map θs : B(H) → B(H) such that θs(eN ) = eN , θs ◦ ρ = ρ, (3) θs ◦ λ = λ ◦ γs ◦ EB, θs(f(XM )) = f(XM − s) (f ∈ C0(R)). (4) These maps need not be normal.
